item.title: 16 dogs rescued from East County apartment now up for adoption
item.description: Many of the 40 dogs that were rescued by the San Diego Humane Society (SDHS) from a La Mesa apartment late last year are ready to be accepted into their new homes.

item.title: Man arrested in Imperial Beach with suspected stolen gun
item.description: A man was arrested in Imperial Beach on Sunday afternoon for possession of a stolen firearm, a loaded 9mm pistol.

item.title: Clairemont High School proposes mascot change after nearly 70 years
item.description: SAN DIEGO, Calif. (FOX 5/KUSI) — After nearly seven decades as the Chieftains, Clairemont High School could soon adopt a new mascot. If approved by the San Diego Unified School District Board of Education, the school would replace “Chieftains” with “Captains” beginning in the 2026-27 school year. item.title: Rep. Levin invites deported couple's daughter to State of the Union address
item.description: Rep. Mike Levin will bring the daughter of a deported immigrant couple as his guest to President Trump's State of the Union address.

item.title: Nick Shirley allegations of voter fraud in San Diego met with pushback
item.description: Nick Shirley, a political influencer, is facing criticism for a viral video alleging voter fraud in San Diego, which was met with pushback from local leaders who accused him of racially targeting Somali businesses in Minnesota.

item.title: San Diego City Council addresses budget gap, services at risk
item.description: The San Diego City Council held its first budget discussion on Monday to address an estimated $120 million budget shortfall in the 2027 fiscal year.

item.title: Baja California hit by aftermath of cartel violence
item.description: Mexican authorities killed the leader of the Jalisco New Generation Cartel, resulting in retaliatory violence across the country, including the burning of vehicles and buildings in Baja California, and prompting the U.S. Embassy to issue a security alert for several Mexican states.

item.title: San Diego woman describes Puerto Vallarta chaos after cartel leader's death
item.description: San Diego resident Leslie Devaney and her daughter were on vacation in Puerto Vallarta when violence erupted after the killing of a cartel leader.

item.title: Powerful cartel boss killed had several California ties
item.description: Nemesio "El Mencho" Oseguera Cervantes, one of Mexico's most powerful cartel bosses and one of the DEA's most sought-after criminal figures, was killed in a military operation in central Mexico and had a criminal history in California.
